newsSince: Realbotix evidence improved after Onconetix highlighted a July 7 UK public-sector/Bloom pilot for socially assistive humanoids and reiterated the pending all-stock transaction to take Realbotix LLC to Nasdaq in 2H26. The transaction remains subject to shareholder/regulatory approvals.

sources.label: Onconetix / Realbotix UK Bloom humanoid pilot
XBOTF quote / market data as of 2026-07-09

verdicts.rankRationale: A fresh care-sector pilot plus the still-live Nasdaq path make the direct humanoid microcap case stronger. Keep risk high because transaction approval, liquidity and actual revenue scale are unresolved.
verdicts.bull: Directest deployed social-robot micro-cap with a Nasdaq path via Onconetix.
verdicts.neutral: Real but tiny; thesis intact yet commercialization unproven.
verdicts.bear: $40M cap, deep losses, RTO/dilution risk; alpha is mostly humanoid beta.
verdicts.primaryCatalyst: Nasdaq RTO close; first scaled deployments
